testcase.name: platform state strings map to states and anything else is ignored
an outgoing call has no ringing state on this side
a missed call is discarded rather than saved as an empty recording
a second call arriving mid-call does not restart the recording
a rejected call after ringing is discarded once and only once
repeated broadcasts of the same state do nothing
an answered incoming call records and is kept
direction is remembered from the start of the call not recomputed at the end
going idle without a call produces nothing
reset clears a call in progress
